subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified omitted-detached Unix cleanup as the new default for this process-tree helper?
rationale: The patch fixes a real gateway SIGTERM path, but it changes shared cleanup behavior for omitted callers and can trade unsafe group signaling for possible descendant leftovers when process-group leadership cannot be verified.

options.title: Accept guarded cleanup
options.body: Land the current approach after CI is resolved, treating direct-PID fallback as the safer default for unverifiable omitted callers.

options.title: Require more caller state
options.body: Ask for any additional known detached-owned cleanup surfaces to pass explicit `detached: true` before merge.

options.title: Pause for a different contract
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want group kill to remain opt-in or want a different process-tree API shape.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the current approach after CI is resolved, treating direct-PID fallback as the safer default for unverifiable omitted callers.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the prior related detached-option contract and explicitly accepted behavior preservation there, making them the strongest routing candidate for the compatibility tradeoff.
